gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-traditional-nu: Noto Traditional Nushu moves with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Over a full page, its bowls fill the line and the text stays approachable, while Azonix above it has no calligraphic swell on any downstroke.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-numans: Azonix looks like bent paperclip, with no swelling anywhere in its strokes. It handles commanding display work, while Numans, a plain sans with hanging s ends and widely pushed tracking, handles the modern, clean reading below.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-onest: Azonix takes the top spot with authority, its capitals barely taller than its lowercase. And Onest, a sans-serif with short ascenders over big bowls, keeps a long page approachable and contemporary, its line thickness gently uniform.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-open-sans: Smooth and unclogged, with bulky lowercase proportions, this body text reads in a thoroughly contemporary way. Open Sans handles that steady reading job, whereas Azonix puts its stress-free curves to work as the commanding display voice.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-orienta: Azonix reads like letters cut from wire, authoritative and wide-mouthed even when shrunk. Orienta, a modern sans with breathing counters and little height gap between cases, is better left at a modest size.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-oxygen: Azonix is drawn as if by a fixed-width nib, which gives its headings a commanding look. And Oxygen, a sans-serif whose curves never close back on themselves, keeps a longer passage clean and contemporary.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-parkinsans: One stroke thickness runs through every letter of Azonix, and its wide mouths stay crisp when shrunk. And Parkinsans, a plain sans with lowercase rising close to its capitals, brings the contemporary reading voice that Azonix leaves to it.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-pathway-extreme: Rounded letters with clear openings and stubby ascenders give this sans a modern, clean read beside a big x-height. And Pathway Extreme can sit a touch larger than you'd expect, while Azonix holds its heading line like a stylus at fixed pressure.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-preahvihear: Azonix holds a steady, marker-like line weight and a commanding stance in its headings. Preahvihear, a sans-serif with a lofty x-height and mouths pried open like oyster shells, takes over for the contemporary reading.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-pt-sans-caption: Authoritative is the mood Azonix sets, every stroke traced at the width of one stylus. But if that heading shrinks, PT Sans Caption, a sans-serif with unclosed, inviting bowls and big-bodied lowercase, would still carry the page.
